name: EngagementLetterManager
tagline: Draft, send, sign, renew and onboard – engagement letters under control.
description: A complete engagement-letter app for accounting, tax, advisory and legal firms: letter register, send/sign pipeline, signature chasing, renewals calendar and an onboarding checklist that gates opening the matter – in one Power Apps code component.
features: Lifecycle rules Draft → In review → Approved → Sent → Signed → Active
Partner approval above a fee threshold
Signature overdue flags and capped reminders
12-month renewals calendar with one-click renewal letters
Configurable onboarding checklist with required steps
Fee calculator (fixed, hourly, capped, retainer, contingent)
Demo mode, sample CSV and Power Fx quick start
